web_hub_more_sub: Your page on ShikkhokPlus that parents can find
web_hub_batches_sub: Choose which batches appear on your page
web_hub_suspended_body: It is not public and cannot be changed. If you think this is a mistake, ask us through Help and we will look at it.
web_hub_check_contact_or_none: A public phone number, or none
web_hub_check_subjects: At least one subject on the batch
web_hub_public_name_latin_help: How your name is spelled in English letters, so people searching in English find you.
web_hub_slug_help: 3 to 60 lowercase English letters, digits or hyphens.
web_hub_slug_taken: Someone else already uses this address.
web_hub_phone_help: The one number shown on your page. Leave empty to show none.
web_hub_save_failed: Your changes were not saved. Nothing you typed is lost.
web_hub_unpublished: Your listing is no longer public.
web_hub_publish_intro: Publishing makes these parts of your page public, so anyone can read them without signing in:
web_hub_publish_item_profile: your public name, headline, biography, qualifications and the area you teach in
web_hub_publish_item_contact: the public phone number you entered, if any
web_hub_publish_item_batches: each batch you separately choose to publish
web_hub_publish_never: Nothing about your students or their guardians is ever shown.
web_hub_publish_unpublish: You can unpublish at any time. Your page then stops being public and your text is kept.
web_hub_publish_agree: I understand and agree to publish my listing
web_hub_batches_empty: You have no active batches yet.
web_hub_batches_owner_first: Publish your own listing first, then publish a batch.
web_hub_batch_flags_help: Say whether to show the fee and the timetable before the first save.
web_hub_consent_title: Your name on a centre’s page
web_hub_consent_toggle: Show my name on the centre’s public listing
web_hub_consent_help: If you do not agree, the centre’s page says “Centre faculty” instead of your name. You can change this at any time.
web_hub_batch_public_title_help: The name parents see for this batch. The name you use for it in your own records is never shown.
web_hub_consent_load_failed: Your centre memberships could not be loaded.
web_hub_photos_help: Every photo is checked before it appears on your public page. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB.
web_hub_photos_load_failed: Your photos could not be loaded.
web_hub_photo_alt_required: Describe the photo in English and Bangla before you choose it.
web_hub_photo_slow: The photo is taking longer than expected to be checked.
web_hub_photo_upload_failed: The photo could not be uploaded. Choose it again to retry.
web_hub_photo_delete_body: It is removed from your page and cannot be restored.
web_hub_report_target_media: A photo on a public page
